description: This file implements a systemd cgroup manager for the OpenContainers project, providing functions to create, configure, and manage cgroups via systemd, including resource limits, path initialization, and process management.

classes.name: UnifiedManager
classes.description: A manager for cgroups using systemd, supporting creation, configuration, and control of cgroups via systemd integration.

methods.name: NewUnifiedManager
methods.description: Creates a new UnifiedManager instance with specified cgroup configuration and path.

methods.name: shouldSetCPUIdle
methods.description: Determines if cpu.idle should be set based on systemd version and input value.

methods.name: unifiedResToSystemdProps
methods.description: Converts cgroups resources unified map to systemd unit properties.

methods.name: genV2ResourcesProperties
methods.description: Generates systemd properties from cgroups resources for v2 cgroup.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies resource settings to the systemd unit associated with the cgroup.

methods.name: AddPid
methods.description: Adds a process ID to the cgroup managed by systemd.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Stops and destroys the systemd unit and associated cgroup.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the cgroup path.

methods.name: getSliceFull
methods.description: Computes the full slice name for systemd, considering rootless mode and parent slice.

methods.name: initPath
methods.description: Initializes the cgroup path based on systemd slice and unit naming.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Freezes or unfreezes the cgroup.

methods.name: GetPids
methods.description: Retrieves PIDs in the cgroup.

methods.name: GetAllPids
methods.description: Retrieves all PIDs in the cgroup.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for the cgroup.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets resource limits and configurations for the cgroup.

methods.name: GetPaths
methods.description: Returns a map of cgroup paths.

methods.name: GetCgroups
methods.description: Returns the cgroups configuration.

methods.name: GetFreezerState
methods.description: Gets the freezer state of the cgroup.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the cgroup path exists.

methods.name: OOMKillCount
methods.description: Returns the count of OOM kills for the cgroup.
